description: Create a webhook for HITL notifications. Webhooks are called when approvals are requested, approved, or rejected. Requires TORK_API_KEY.

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to. Options: approval_requested, approval_approved, approval_rejected, approval_timeout. Defaults to ['approval_requested', 'approval_timeout']

url.description: URL to receive webhook POST requests

name: tork_create_webhook
